name: adversarial-validator
description: An isolated, adversarial subagent that validates a security finding before you report it: evidence-only (no hunting context, so it never inherits the finder's optimism), platform-aware severity anchoring (Bugcrowd VRT + CVSS 3.1 for HackerOne / Intigriti / YesWeHack / Synack / CVD / CVE), an instrument-artifact (false-positive) catalog, and a blunt SUBMIT / LEAD / KILL verdict.
